title: Every page load fetches fonts from Google's CDN, contradicting the app's central privacy claim
detail: index.html preconnects to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com and pulls Inter and Playfair Display on load. The README and the profile picker both tell the user 'everything stays in this browser'. In fact every visit announces itself to Google's font CDN before any AI feature is touched, including for users who never enter a key. Together with the quiz texture CDN (S056) that is two third-party requests in an app that markets itself as local-first. Self-hosting the two font families removes both the claim conflict and the render-blocking round trip.

title: No global handler for unhandled promise rejections
detail: At least four findings (S085 exports, S120 Goodreads import, S166 profile creation, S158 summary lookup) manifest as a promise that rejects into nothing. A single window unhandledrejection listener routing to the existing toast store would turn every one of them from silent into visible, without touching the individual call sites.

title: The favicon is an absolute path that breaks under a project-page base
detail: href="/favicon.svg" resolves to the domain root, not to /<repo>/. Consistent with S151 — the deployment target the README promises has not been exercised.

title: Markdown export does not escape special characters in user or model text
detail: A title containing a leading # or a pipe, or notes containing an unclosed code fence, produce structurally wrong markdown in the exported file. The export is the app's only data-portability path for prose.

title: No Open Graph or social preview metadata
detail: For a project whose adoption depends on being shared, the page has title and description but no og:title, og:description, og:image or twitter:card, so every link posted anywhere renders as a bare URL.
